title: thymus serpyllum var. arenarius
intro: Thymus serpyllum var. arenarius, commonly known as Sea Thyme or Dune Thyme, is a type of low-growing, flowering plant that belongs to the thyme family. This plant has been traditionally used to promote health and well-being, with its health benefits including its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce stress. The therapeutic actions of Sea Thyme include its ability to stimulate the immune system, improve respiratory function, and act as an antioxidant, making it a popular natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Thymus serpyllum var. arenarius include thymol, carvacrol, and borneol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
